newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran gas refining capacity stands at 160 mn cum.
newsitem.headline: Iran gas refining capacity stands at 160 mn cum.

text.p: Iran's daily natural gas refining capacity has reached 160 million cubic metres a day, the head of Iran's state gas firm was quoted as saying on Thursday.
Hamdollah Mohammad-Nejad, managing director of National Iranian Gas Company, said that output had increased from 22 million cubic metres a day in 1978-1979.
Iran had signed deals to export gas to Turkey and Armenia and was in negotiations to sell its gas to India, Pakistan and Azerbaijan, the official IRNA news-agency quoted Mohammad-Nejad as saying.
